title: basic-auth workspace create gate: creating a new workspace-scoped resource must check _user_can_create_in_workspace via a validate_can_create_* validator
answers: Who is allowed to create a gateway secret when workspaces are enabled?
Why is a user with USE on a workspace still denied creating an experiment or a registered model?
I want to add a create route for a new resource type in the basic-auth server. Which validator should gate it?
Where is the workspace create permission for gateway secrets handled?
body:
Path: mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:validate_can_create_gateway_secret, with the sibling validate_can_create_experiment, validate_can_create_registered_model and validate_can_create_mcp_server, is registered in the before-request validator map for the create route (CreateGatewaySecret is mapped there). These validators decide whether a new workspace-scoped resource may be persisted.
Rule: A validator for creating a new workspace-scoped resource returns mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:_user_can_create_in_workspace() and does not reuse per-resource checks. The after-request MANAGE grant only records the creator as owner and must not be the gate. Keep the create validators consistent so that a user denied one create route is denied the others that cross the same workspace boundary.
Symptom: A user without a workspace create grant could create gateway secrets while being denied experiments and registered models in the same workspace.
Constraints: With MLFLOW_ENABLE_WORKSPACES off, the same validators allow any authenticated user, which keeps single-tenant behavior. Model-definition and endpoint creates still gate on USE of the referenced resources rather than a workspace create grant; that policy was intentionally left for a follow-up, so do not assume the create-grant rule applies to them.
applies: Basic-auth server create routes for workspace-scoped resources (experiments, registered models, MCP servers, gateway secrets); not for gateway model-definition or endpoint creation.
says: Users without permission to create in a workspace can still add gateway secrets.
Workspace permissions block creating experiments and models but unexpectedly permit adding gateway secrets.
Block users lacking workspace creation permissions from creating any workspace-scoped resources.
Keep creation access consistent across experiments, registered models, and AI gateway secrets.
search: Creation routes for workspace-scoped resources in the basic-auth server must verify authorization via mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:_user_can_create_in_workspace using before-request validators such as validate_can_create_gateway_secret, validate_can_create_experiment, validate_can_create_registered_model, and validate_can_create_mcp_server. After-request MANAGE ownership grants merely record the owner and must not act as the authorization gate. When MLFLOW_ENABLE_WORKSPACES is disabled, these validators allow any authenticated user, and gateway model-definition or endpoint creation routes are excluded from this rule.
